title: rill.jsonc
description: Configuration for a rill project. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, so an editor can validate and complete the file.

name.description: Name the worker is deployed under.

scheme.description: Scheme used when an absolute URL has to be built.

canonicalHost.description: Host used for canonical links and the sitemap.

css.description: How stylesheets are processed and delivered.

inlineLimit.description: A stylesheet smaller than this is written into the document; anything larger is served as its own cached file. "0" links every stylesheet.

fragments.description: How a deferred fragment reaches the page.

budget.description: How long the tail mode waits for a loader, as a Go duration such as "25ms". Only valid with deferred "tail".

i18n.description: Languages, and how a request is mapped onto one.

prefixDefault.description: Give the default locale a path prefix of its own.

reserved.description: Prefixes the router refuses to give to a page. Setting this replaces the defaults.

mode.description: "partial" sends only the part of the document that changed.

hosts.description: Host to locale mapping. Required by the subdomain i18n mode.

trustedProxy.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers. Only turn this on behind a proxy that sets them.

maxBodySize.description: Largest request body a submission or an api route may carry, as a size like "8mb" or "512kb".

trustedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to make state-changing cross-origin requests, as scheme://host[:port].

maxConnections.description: Largest number of connections the native server accepts at once. Omit for no limit; the worker target is bounded by the platform.

react.description: Which engine islands are bundled against.
